unlockIndex._comment: First zero-based campaign index eligible for rolling terrain; public levels 1–5 stay flat.

selectionProbability._comment: Seeded rolling-meadow probability after unlock; an implementation tuning choice.

maximumRelief._comment: Experimental hard ceiling on total playable relief, doubled from the accepted 4.5m profile; all traversable grades remain at most30degrees.

maximumSlopeDegrees._comment: Fixed agreed hard cap on traversable terrain/support grades. Lower caps require re-deriving the analytic field and bridge parameters; this is not an independent tuning knob.

waveAmplitude._comment: Experimental pasture-wave amplitude, doubled alongside its horizontal length scales to increase actual relief while preserving wave gradients.

valleyLift._comment: Experimental mean pasture lift above channel floor, doubled to4m; river normalization still preserves its wet edge.

channelDepth._comment: Channel floor below the smooth downstream reference plane.

waterDepth._comment: River surface above its channel floor.

downstreamDrop._comment: Half of the bounded smooth downhill river elevation range.

bridgeLift._comment: Maximum smooth deck lift above channel terrain; joins with zero end derivative.

poolMaximumSlopeDegrees._comment: Large rain pools require grades strictly below this threshold across their footprint.

poolMaximumHeightRange._comment: Maximum ground height variation across one standing-water footprint.

poolLowlandHeight._comment: Maximum pool ground elevation above the local downstream reference.

waterEdgeInset._comment: Extra channel-bed width beyond the physical water ribbon; retains full-width water through sampled bends.

lowlandBlendWidth._comment: Smooth analytic transition from low channel verge to stronger banks; broad enough for continuous shared ground and road sampling.

bankShelfWidth._comment: Narrow lowland verge away from bridges; hill waves can rise close to ordinary riverbanks.

bridgeShelfWidth._comment: Local low-gradient landing corridor beside each bridge; fades along the river rather than flattening every bank.

bridgeBlendLength._comment: Gaussian length along each river for smooth transitions between gentle bridge approaches and higher banks.

bankRiseScale._comment: Experimental dry-bank distance expansion reduced from2 to1.9 to widen the higher valley transition and preserve the30-degree maximum grade. This is a support-grade correction, not the deferred compact-bank feature.

elevatedBridgeChance._comment: Independent seeded chance for a rolling meadow to offer higher-bank crossings on its first river.

elevatedBridgeBankSetback._comment: Compact elevated spans land on raised banks within 2.75m of each physical water edge.

elevatedBridgeMinimumClearance._comment: Both full-width landing banks must stand at least this far above local water to select an elevated crossing.

elevatedBridgeCrown._comment: Gentle smooth crown above the bank-to-bank deck chord; zero height and grade offset at landings.

elevatedBridgeTangentPower._comment: Localizes exact bank tangent matching near each landing so stronger pasture crests cannot pull the elevated deck down into the channel.

elevatedBridgeMaximumLandingSlopeDegrees._comment: Candidate bank footprints must have gentler grades than the hard30-degree traversable cap.

elevatedBridgeRiverSeparation._comment: Extra separation before the first river when elevated bridges share a meadow with a second crossing, retaining room around extended rails.

elevatedBridgeApproachPadding._comment: Extra common dry turning-plane clearance beyond first-river approaches on elevated-crossing candidates.

waveLengths._comment: Experimental rounded-wave length scales doubled with amplitude; wider hills preserve the maximum slope while doubling relief.

waveWeights._comment: Normalized hill-wave weights. A dominant primary wave prevents cancellation from flattening the visible crest/valley pattern.

poolSearchOffsets._comment: Deterministic lateral journey-verge fallback offsets for finding eligible lowland pools on stronger rolling relief. Placement remains capped by maxPuddles and physical eligibility.

bankVariation._comment: Seeded change in ordinary low-bank shelf width, metres.

bankVariationLength._comment: Length scale of the smooth seeded bank-width variation.

compactBankLiftFraction._comment: Fraction of remaining pasture rise reached beside compact elevated crossings; retuned for the accepted doubled hill relief.

soilStartDegrees._comment: Slope where grass begins blending into granular soil.

soilFullDegrees._comment: Slope where ground becomes fully granular soil.

maximumBankSlopeDegrees._comment: User-authorized cap for localized compact bank faces; pasture and bridge support remain limited to30degrees. This cap is checked by measurements, not enforced by clipping the smooth surface.

elevatedBridgeFieldClearance._comment: Retain established meadow layout breathing room independently of compact bridge span setbacks; avoids moving scenery and goals closer to spawn.
